triggerCases.prompt: Can this implementation be much simpler? Look for code we can remove instead of adding more machinery.
Review this pull request for correctness and test coverage.
Simplify this module, update its tests, and commit the refactor.
Profile this list and review whether it meets our rendering budget.

outputCases.prompt: Perform a read-only simplification review of this change. Focus on achieving the same behavior with less code.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A deletion-first review that replaces duplicated synchronized state with the existing shared filter while preserving the stated UI contract.
assertions: The review identifies the existing filterProducts function as the direct path and names the new state, effect, and normalization helper that can be removed.
The proposed alternative preserves synchronous filtering, case-insensitive matching, and the required live result count.
The review does not add a new abstraction, dependency, or speculative memoization layer.
Any unproven requirement or runtime claim remains a verification gap rather than justification for deletion.

outputCases.prompt: Perform the mandatory read-only simplicity pass and report whether this implementation can be materially simplified.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An explicit no-findings result that preserves the minimal implementation and does not invent an optional refactor.
assertions: The review reports no material simplification finding because every part of the implementation serves a stated public contract.
The review does not propose deleting the component, changing its public API, replacing it with a new abstraction, or moving its behavior into a helper.
The review distinguishes a shorter aesthetic rewrite from a material deletion opportunity.
The review records no unsupported runtime, accessibility, or consumer claims.

outputCases.prompt: Perform the simplicity pass and return the findings in chat only. Do not create a review artifact or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only simplicity review returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the simplicity findings directly in chat.
The workflow does not create or open a local review document.
The workflow does not modify source or post to GitHub.
